newsitem.title: USA: EnviroSource stake held by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: EnviroSource stake held by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Tuesday it holds a 5.14 percent stake in EnviroSource Inc or 2,072,900 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 254,500 common shares bought between December 19, 1996 and February 27, 1997 at prices ranging from $1.875 to $2.625 per share.

EnviroSource, based in Stamford, Conn., supplies to industrial customers of long-term, specialized services, primarily the recycling, handling, stabilization or land filling of environmentally sensitive wastes or by-products.
